texts.zh:
我们与一种不同类型的文明进行了第一次接触——这类文明通常不愿与其他国家开展外交。

能够与这类文明进行的外交行动十分有限，然而他们也有可能偶尔会决定主动接触我们。
texts.en:
We have made First Contact with a different type of civilization - one which is generally unwilling to engage in Diplomacy with others.

The diplomatic actions we can take with civilizations like this are limited, however they may decide to contact us from time to time.
